run_optimizer: run the DeepMimic multi-clip RL optimizer main loop via the run function
shutdown_world: shutdown the RL world and log the shutdown message using the shutdown function
build_world: build an RL world from command line args using the build_world function
main_entry: run the main entry point that builds the world, runs optimization, and shuts down
review_run_loop: review the run function infinite loop that calls update_world with the timestep
